title: ThinkAct: Vision-Language-Action Reasoning via Reinforced Visual Latent Planning

layout.note: A grey-framed feedback box and the Thinking robot on the left; to the right three aligned rows, each a capability label, a dashed reasoning box, a big white outlined block arrow and a dashed result box; the Acting label and a robot arm sit between the reasoning boxes and the results.

lesson: Show thinking before acting as a left-to-right fan-out: a feedback box with scored rollouts and a labelled curved arrow into a cartoon thinker, then one row per capability pairing real reasoning text with highlighted spans and its result through a big outlined arrow.
